text:
Anya: Quick q — our rollout dashboard shows canary vs baseline p50/p95 but it's hard to attribute which signal actually triggered the safety gate. Can we add per-split signal attribution + a drilldown that highlights which metric crossed the threshold? e.g. route=/chat model=gpt-redwood-2 split=5%

Mike: Totally. We need rollout_id attached to traces and metrics. Right now telemetry is aggregated by route only. +1 for adding rollout tags to metrics so we can slice by split weight.

Lucy: We should be careful about cardinality. Proposal: make a rollout_tag optional and emitted only while a rollout is active. Console can opt-in per-rollout to enable rollout-level tags for 30m/1h.

Sam: From the alerts side — we get heaps of false positives if we just look at single metrics. Suggest a composite safety gate: require delta_p95 > 20ms AND error_rate_delta > 0.5% for 5m before tripping. Ability to pick AND/OR and set windows per-rule would help.

Anya: UI note: add "safety gate templates" in the rollout config (default templates: latency+errors, throughput regressions). In the timeline, show which sub-rule fired and link to the exact metric query and traces.

Jordan: We can emit a deploy event when a rollout starts so downstream systems can flip on telemetry. Example event:

{ "event": "rollout.start", "rollout_id": "r-2026-03-18-01", "model": "gpt-redwood-2", "weight": 5, "route": "/chat" }

That lets metrics pipeline auto-enable rollout tags for that id.

DeployBot: deploybot: acknowledged rollout hook idea. I can emit the event when we create a rollout via the API; will add a toggle to the API to suppress if needed.

infra-bot: infra-bot: added metric prototype: `rollout_active{rollout_id="r-2026-03-18-01"}` and `service.latency.p95_by_rollout{rollout_id}` to staging Prometheus. Example Datadog query posted in #eng-infra.

Mike: Example Datadog delta query: `avg(last_5m): service.latency.p95_by_rollout{rollout_id:123} - service.latency.p95{route:/chat}`. Also: show CI/shaded area on the delta to avoid overreacting to noisy spikes — consider Bayesian t-test or bootstrap for quick CI.

Olivia: UX idea: in rollout details show a small sparkline of delta with shaded 95% CI, a short "why" panel listing top contributing routes/tags, and 3 sample traces that illustrate the regression. Keep it compact so it fits in the Canary card.

Sam: Action items: (1) eng-infra: add rollout_id tag and opt-in window; (2) eng-platform: add composite safety-gate template + expose which sub-rule fired in timeline; (3) eng-releases: wire deploybot to emit `rollout.start` events; (4) product/console: mock for sparkline + why panel. I'll open tickets and tag owners. :+1:
